known_failures_or_gaps.detail: Wolfgang never waits at a door: ward_serv is fully open 70 frames before he arrives (sensor range 4.6 m). The brief asked for an approach-wait-open-pass beat. Needs an authored stop in the timeline (approval: changes pacing).
Engine v10 Wolfgang is a grey-block 3D placeholder (top hat, coat). The approved sprite atlas exists but is not wired into v10.
After first detection (frame 3053) MINO stays locked on even when line of sight is blocked (98 of 300 strip frames blocked). No search state yet.
Authored MAP_CHECKIN_3 says MINO blip passes through a wall. Conflicts with the new rule that the map mirrors world transforms. Not implemented; needs decision.
MAP_CHECKIN_5 is authored on an EXT row (frame 5988) as a seamless rise; v10d only turns MAP rows into arcade maps, so check-in 5 is not an arcade map yet.
Actors are lit by a live hemisphere + overhead directional approximating the baked ceiling lamps; no light probes. Contact shadows are blob approximations (labelled in DEBUG).

Static items NOT in the bake (lit live): lyric-dressing props and signs, door frames and headers, anchor-bed pillow/throw, car park, ceiling truss. Zone floor tints use the floor lightmap but were baked as plain concrete.
